description: Production workflow-session registry with append-only lifecycle-v0 execution evidence.
append_policy: Add one immutable schema-v2 workflow_session record only when a future production baseline or treatment actually executes. One replicate is one complete ordered lifecycle workflow.

baseline_pool.identity_policy: frozen-protocol-and-replicate; execution date is metadata only

install.policy: Run Codex from a fresh lane-specific CODEX_HOME with auth only, no MCP servers, no global instructions, no hooks, no skills/plugins, isolated HOME/PYTHONUSERBASE/XDG/TMPDIR, and a preflight artifact proving empty MCP config.

reset.policy: Delete the lane-specific Codex home and run-local HOME/PYTHONUSERBASE/XDG/TMPDIR before each run; verify no stale indexes or generated profile files survive.

registry_entry.notes: Canonical Codex CLI no-MCP substrate baseline. Codex native shell/edit/file/git/verifier operations are allowed; MCP, retrieval, compression, memory, token-saving add-ons, global instructions, hooks, skills/plugins, and warm indexes are forbidden.

network_isolation.model_shell_enforcement: seccomp denies AF_INET and AF_INET6 socket creation for the shell process and descendants

runtime.isolation_policy: fresh lane-specific Codex home/tool data; provider-only network with model shell and Codex web search disabled; sequential one-task prompt delivery; concealed tests removed before model-visible root commit

baseline_pool_reference.comparison_policy: paired baseline and treatment must share this baseline pool fingerprint and replicate

task_sequence.reset_policy: reset source checkout, profile home, tool state, indexes, caches, generated config, and agent home before the lane; preserve repository, thread, tool, index, cache, and agent state across every sequential prompt

leakage_controls.model_writable_surface: target repository plus isolated model-output directory
remaining_limitations: Future regression code is present from lane start, while future prompts and concealed acceptance assets remain controller-only.
Task semantics and verifier names may still be searchable if the model intentionally uses external network access.

persist_between_tasks: repository source working tree and model-facing Git metadata from one composite broken-start root
memory/state stores enabled by the active profile

cumulative_token_usage.accounting_basis: Codex-reported token volume; monetary cost estimation is out of scope

artifacts.final_diff_basis: ordered cumulative checkpoints plus final cumulative source diff from one composite root

interpretation.notes: Provider-backed lane completed with clean integrity; verifier and review outcomes are diagnostic model-behavior evidence and do not gate token accounting.
interpretation.scope_note: Full warm-state lane; all regressions are preseeded, prompts are disclosed sequentially, and concealed verification runs only after the final prompt.

install.policy: Run default `headroom wrap codex -- codex exec ...` unless the protocol explicitly names an ablation. Record generated Codex config, MCP registrations, context-tool setup, tokensave install/index artifacts, versions, and environment variables before scoring.

reset.policy: Record disable/uninstall commands and verify no stale proxy config, MCP server registration, context-tool instruction, tokensave index/cache, Serena state, or generated profile survives into the next run.

evaluation_protocol.hypothesis_boundary: Measures default Headroom behavior through its Codex wrapper/integration on coding tasks.
evaluation_protocol.token_accounting_boundary: provider-reported task usage with verifier acceptance; per-request Headroom headers are secondary diagnostics only.

registry_entry.notes: Primary Headroom candidate profile for Codex integration. Headroom is not a Codex stack integrator; it is a broader compression/proxy framework with a Codex wrapper. Do not disable Headroom-managed default surfaces unless the run is explicitly labeled as an ablation.
registry_entry.deferred_reason: Selected for the next lifecycle-v0 natural-use treatment round after the first ten screens; primary profile requires its registered companion ablation before component conclusions.
